prompt: Badge only supports a color prop right now. Add a size prop with sm and lg options that change the padding and text size, without breaking the existing color variants.
expected_output: Badge gains a size prop whose sm/lg variants are complete, statically written Tailwind class names -- a lookup table or branching that returns full class strings -- rather than a template literal that completes a utility name with an interpolated value. Every class that ships is a full literal token somewhere in the source.

expectations.text: No Tailwind class name is completed by interpolating into the middle of a utility name
A complete Tailwind text-size utility class appears as a literal token
No component lands in the wrong folder
Nothing new at the repository root
